security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'

bundle.longDescription: CosmoRisk loads real near-Earth asteroid orbits from NASA/JPL, propagates them with planetary perturbations, finds close approaches to Earth, estimates impact probability with Monte Carlo sampling of the orbit covariance, and simulates deflection missions.
